title: Mordified Restoration of Tensor Veli Palatini in Cleft Palate Repair
brief_summary: to study the benefical audiological and/or otological effect by mordified restoration of tensor veli palatini in cleft palate repair compared to traditional Langenbeck's repair and merely levator veli palatini restoration.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of cleft palate.
* Primary palate repair.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe general disease
* Confirmed hereditary hearing loss or neuropathic hearing loss.
* Received any kind of audiological or otological therapy before.
* Patients and/or his/her don't want to continue the clinical trial.
